accepted_constraints.identity: Cathay Mansions / 华懋公寓 = 锦江饭店北楼 / 锦北楼; it is a separate historic building from Cathay Hotel / 华懋饭店 / 和平饭店北楼 and from Grosvenor House / 峻岭公寓 / 锦江饭店中楼.

address_policy.resolution: Retain the fixed inventory address as provenance; publish the discrepancy instead of silently replacing the source. Identity is resolved by names, road junction, photos and separately reviewed map footprint; exact current/historic door-number correspondence remains unverified.

accepted_constraints.construction: Official text says work began in 1925 and completed in 1929. An earlier paragraph separately says an investment was made in 1928; these are retained as different narrative statements, not forced into one start year.
accepted_constraints.design_and_structure: 公和洋行设计、王荪记营造厂承建、钢筋混凝土框架结构。

height_and_storeys.measurement_endpoint: Not specified for either value. No evidence here determines parapet, principal roof, top equipment or original/current grade endpoint.
height_and_storeys.model_policy: A model may adopt 57 m as a declared author envelope convention based on the chapter’s primary value; it must retain the 65 m / 13-storey alternative and may not call any derived level elevations or highest roof point measured.
height_and_storeys.visible_floor_allocation: Not certified from photos; substantial lower garden-side occlusion and contradictory text counts prevent claiming a complete measured floor schedule.

accepted_constraints.plan_and_skin: Official text: 一字形平面，北面凸出两部分；褐色面砖、白浆勾线、石料窗框与垂直线条、白框方格钢窗。 Photos confirm facade treatment and street recess, not a surveyed footprint.
accepted_constraints.scope: Only the Cathay historic principal building. Separately mapped garden buildings, small auditorium, Grosvenor House, other Jinjiang hotel blocks, New Jinjiang Hotel and Peace Hotel are excluded.

unresolved: 57 m / 14 storeys versus 65 m / 13 storeys, and the endpoint/original grade of both heights.
1925 start and 1928 investment occur in separate official paragraphs; this review does not invent an explanation.
Complete roof plan, east boundary elevation, both northern projections in plan, roof equipment dimensions, exact windows/bay spacing, floor heights, settlement amount and hidden passages.

decision: Identity and principal visible architectural treatment supported. Exact global footprint remains a separate map review; hidden sides and derived dimensions must remain explicitly estimated, with the reported height/address alternatives retained.
